description_expanded: If you’ve set your sights on the perfect vacay, look no further than Take it Eeaasy, a magnificent lake-front home located in the private gated community of Carillon Beach. Gorgeous views and luxurious furnishings make this home away from home an ideal retreat. Just steps to the beach and conveniently located near shopping and restaurants, you’ll find everything you need and more! Take it Eeaasy is a stunning cottage-style home with three bedrooms and four baths accommodating up to ten. One step inside this luxurious, custom-built retreat and you’ll be in vacation mode. Hardwood floors, natural finishes, and gorgeous furnishings welcome you into the space specifically designed for comfort and relaxation. The living area is filled with cozy furnishings and plenty of space to accommodate a crowd. Calming hues and expansive windows scattered throughout the dining area add to the ambiance in this open-concept space, housing a dining table with seating for six. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances, plenty of cabinet space, and a breakfast bar with seating for four. Unwind and take in coastal breezes on one of two screened porches, one off the main floor and the other off of the master suite. Generous, comfortable bedrooms await at the end of the day, with king-sized beds and en suite baths in both the master and guest suites and a bunk room the kids will love with a flat-screen TV. A washer and dryer are nestled in a nook behind closed doors for added convenience. The whole family will enjoy the exclusive Carillon resort community with plenty of amenities. Challenge one another to a game of tennis or basketball then lounge by one of three pools. You’ll find several children’s play areas and great restaurants for a quick lunch or celebratory evening meal. Walking paths and beautiful landscaping throughout making traversing to the beach a quick and relaxing occasion! Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund. The pictured golf cart belongs to the owner and is not for guest use. Golf Carts: All rental golf carts must be rented through Coastal Cars & Carts 850-999-7733, which is the exclusive vendor in Carillon beach. No other rental carts will be allowed on the property. Beach Service: Carillon Beach is serviced by Vacayzen. 1 complimentary set is provided seasonally March 31st-October 31st (2 chairs, 1 umbrella) Note: Close to your arrival dates you will receive a QR code to pay for parking passes.
